outcome: Positive predictive value of normal head ultrasound
cohort: Preterm infants younger than 32 weeks gestational age admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit at Phramongkutklao Hospital between January 1, 2014 and December 31, 2018.
finding: Repeating head ultrasound at day 30 or later in preterm infants with initial abnormalities may be more helpful than repeating as early as day 7.
